mission: Empowering communities through technology, education, economic inclusion and wellness, and supporting persons with disabilities to participate fully.
vision: To be a beacon of hope driving inclusive growth and social transformation across Kenya's rural communities.
belief: Real change begins when people are seen, supported and empowered.

founder.name: Mercy Wanjau
bio: Mercy Wanjau is a commercial lawyer, governance professional and public sector leader. She serves as Secretary to the Cabinet of the Republic of Kenya.

Her expertise spans ICT regulation, policy development, corporate governance and public administration. She previously served as Acting Director-General and Director of Legal Services at the Communications Authority of Kenya, where she played a key role in shaping the country's digital and regulatory landscape.
founder.why: The Foundation brings that experience to the places where access is thinnest. It works with rural communities, starting in Kirinyaga County, so that the opportunities shaping Kenya's future, from digital work to international languages and fairer markets for farmers, reach the people too often left out of them.

principles.name: Integrity
principles.text: Honest about what works, what does not, and what we are still learning.

principles.name: Inclusivity
principles.text: Programmes designed with women, youth and persons with disabilities, not only for them.

principles.name: Innovation
principles.text: Practical tools, from language clubs to digital labs, built for rural realities.

principles.name: Accountability
principles.text: Clear reporting to the communities, donors and partners we serve.

principles.name: Community-centred development
principles.text: Communities set the priorities; we bring partners, skills and resources.

principles.name: Sustainability
principles.text: Models designed to outlast our involvement and to scale to new counties.

codeOfConduct.name: Act with respect
codeOfConduct.text: Treat every person with kindness, patience and dignity.

codeOfConduct.name: Be accountable
codeOfConduct.text: Deliver on promises and own outcomes, both successes and lessons.

codeOfConduct.name: Protect confidentiality
codeOfConduct.text: Safeguard the trust and privacy of the people we serve.

codeOfConduct.name: Promote team spirit
codeOfConduct.text: Value collaboration, communication and shared growth.

codeOfConduct.name: Uphold non-discrimination
codeOfConduct.text: Reject all forms of bias, prejudice and harassment.

codeOfConduct.name: Lead by example
codeOfConduct.text: Embody the Foundation's values in every action, however small.
